question: Describe a time you refactored legacy code. What was your approach?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with mid-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: I refactored a 2000-line authentication module that was difficult to test. Situation: new features were slow to implement. I wrote tests first to capture current behavior, then extracted smaller functions, and finally replaced the old module incrementally. Result: deployment time reduced by 40% and new features took 50% less time to implement.
